propositions: A project overlay entry keyed by a built-in overlay id cannot currently extend that overlay's triggers; only standalone project.* criteria are supported
The registry functions glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays read only committed routing and hardcoded regexes, preventing project-driven trigger vocabulary addition
Projects need to add trigger_tokens and applies_to globs to built-in overlays (e.g. concurrency, performance) as an additive union rather than a replacement
A new helper project_trigger_extensions should read project overlay raw code_review entries directly and return per-overlay-id trigger_tokens and applies_to lists for union in the trigger functions
Both trigger functions must union project trigger extensions with committed triggers while preserving existing behavior when no project overlay is present
